meta.title: 下巴的美学密码
meta.title_en: The Aesthetic Code of the Chin
meta.topic: 医美 · 面部美学 · 下巴

scenes.title_cn: 下巴的密码藏在三条线上
scenes.title_en: The Chin's Code Lives in Three Lines
scenes.context: 下巴好不好看，不只看长度，而是看三条线：正面看轮廓线，侧面看下颌线，45 度看衔接线。这三条线共同决定下巴与整张脸的匹配度。
sentences: 下巴的美学密码，藏在三条线里。
The aesthetic code of the chin hides in three lines.
aesthetic code（美学密码）
正面看轮廓线，侧面看下颌线。
The front view shows the outline; the profile shows the jawline.
outline（轮廓线）
45 度角，看下巴与面颊的衔接。
At 45 degrees, you check how the chin connects to the cheeks.
connect（衔接）
paraphrase: Three lines decide whether a chin works.
「每个角度各有侧重」换种说法
Each angle reveals a different flaw or strength.
scenes.speak: The aesthetic code of the chin hides in three lines. The front view shows the outline; the profile shows the jawline. At 45 degrees, you check how the chin connects to the cheeks.

scenes.title_cn: 长度之外：位置与弧度同样重要
scenes.title_en: Beyond Length: Position and Curve Matter Too
scenes.context: 下巴的完美不是『越长越好』。往前收的适度突度、与下唇和颈部形成的连续弧度，比绝对长度更影响美感。过突显凶，过收显懦。
sentences: 下巴不是越长越好。
A longer chin isn't automatically a better one.
automatically（自动地）
适度往前，才显得立体。
A moderate forward projection reads as sculpted.
projection（突度）
突过了显凶，收过了显弱。
Too much projection looks harsh; too little looks weak.
harsh（凶/锐利）
paraphrase: The chin has a sweet spot between harsh and weak.
scenes.speak: A longer chin isn't automatically a better one. A moderate forward projection reads as sculpted. Too much projection looks harsh; too little looks weak.

scenes.title_cn: 设计结论：下巴是下半张脸的锚点
scenes.title_en: The Takeaway: The Chin Anchors the Lower Face
scenes.context: 下巴承担着承接下唇、延展下颌、决定侧脸收尾的责任，是下半张脸的『锚点』。评估方案时先看三条线是否协调，再看长度与突度是否匹配整体比例。
sentences: 下巴是下半张脸的锚点。
The chin is the anchor of the lower face.
anchor（锚点）
它决定侧脸从哪里收尾。
It decides where the profile ends.
where the profile ends（侧脸收尾）
先看三条线，再看长度和突度。
Check the three lines first, then length and projection.
then（然后）
paraphrase: Read the chin in the context of the whole profile.
scenes.speak: The chin is the anchor of the lower face. It decides where the profile ends. Check the three lines first, then length and projection.

practice: Three lines decide the chin's aesthetics.
「适度突度显得立体」怎么表达？
A moderate projection reads as sculpted.
「下巴是下半脸的锚点」用英文怎么说？
The chin anchors the lower face.
Too much projection looks harsh; too little looks weak.
pitfalls: Match length to the three lines and overall proportion.
Raw length without context creates imbalance.
Judge the chin only from the front.
Each angle exposes a different problem.
Assume more projection is always better.
Over-projection looks aggressive, under-projection looks weak.
Read it as the anchor of the whole lower face.
A chin only works in context with lips, jaw, and neck.
